question: A can do certain piece of work in 20 days. B is 25% more efficient than A, and C is 20% more efficient than B. A and C work together for 5 days. B alone will complete the remaining work in:
solution:
Given:

A can complete a certain work in = 20 days

B is 25% more efficient than A, and C is 20% more efficient than B

 A and C work together for 5 days

Formula Used:

Work done = efficiency × days

**Calculation :**

Efficiency of A (A’s 1 day’s work) = 1/20

Efficiency of B (B’s 1 day’s work) = 1/20 × (125/100) = 1/16

Efficiency of C (C’s 1 day’s work) = 1/16 × (120/100) = 3/40

Let remaining work B complete in x days.

According to the question,

5(1/20 + 3/40) + x/16 = 1

⇒ 5[(2 + 3)/40] + x/16 = 1

⇒ 5/8 + x/16 = 1

⇒ x/16 = 1 - (5/8)

⇒ x/16 = 3/8

⇒ x = 6 days

**∴ B alone will complete the remaining work in 6 days.**
